subject.title: Reduce tool schema token overhead (~3,500 tok/session)

question: Which token-overhead reduction path should own the next increment for this canonical tracker?
rationale: The source proves the overhead is real, but the remaining fixes trade off prompt size against provider compatibility, channel behavior, plugin API shape, and default runtime semantics.

options.title: Sequence incremental core reductions
options.body: Prioritize the already-identified P0/P1 subtasks that preserve current defaults: Tooling text duplication, empty effective tool lists, message-schema pruning, and cron description slimming.

options.title: Sponsor lazy schema API first
options.body: Treat deferred or tiered tool schemas as the product direction and design the plugin/provider contract before further piecemeal pruning.

options.title: Defer to opt-in mitigations
options.body: Leave defaults unchanged for now and direct large-catalog users to Tool Search, tool policy, and bootstrap/context knobs while collecting more measurements.

recommendation.title: Sequence incremental core reductions
recommendation.body: Prioritize the already-identified P0/P1 subtasks that preserve current defaults: Tooling text duplication, empty effective tool lists, message-schema pruning, and cron description slimming.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete provided the latest concrete maintainer review and routing direction in the issue discussion.
